gaps.sentence: Everyone says she takes ___ her grandmother.
gaps.explanation: take after a relative = resemble them in character/looks.

gaps.sentence: The players are gearing ___ for the final.
gaps.explanation: gear up for = prepare for a big event.

gaps.sentence: The deal fell ___ at the last minute.
gaps.explanation: fall through = (a plan/deal) fail to happen.

gaps.sentence: The bonus made up ___ all the overtime we had done.
gaps.explanation: make up FOR something = compensate for it.

gaps.sentence: Don't ___ up all the milk — we need some for breakfast.
gaps.explanation: use up = finish the whole supply of something.

gaps.sentence: I bumped ___ my neighbour at the dentist's.
gaps.explanation: bump into somebody = meet by chance.

gaps.sentence: The caterpillar will turn ___ a butterfly.
The film didn't live up ___ my expectations.
gaps.explanation: live up TO something = be as good as expected.
